summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by ArcelorMittal, a Luxembourg-based steelmaker, announcing the pricing of a $1 billion senior note offering (5.375% notes due 2036). The net proceeds of approximately $987 million are for general corporate purposes, and the offering is scheduled to close on May 19, 2026. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing includes a prospectus and forward-looking statements. There are no terms related to acquisitions, divestitures, activism, or any of the enumerated categories. It is a standard bond issue disclosure.
